summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in what proved a frustrating afternoon, with the Bach creating plenty of chances but unable to capitalize on them and undone by soft defending. Saul Shotton's late volley gave them hope deep into added time, but it wasn't quite enough to salvage a point. The side will be looking to bounce back quickly when they face Stafford Town on Saturday.
